methods.label: Find the time for one task
methods.explanation:
The interval from \(1{:}00\) PM to \(2{:}40\) PM covers exactly two tasks. It lasts \(60+40=100\) minutes. Since the tasks take equal amounts of time, each takes
\[
100\div2=50\text{ minutes}.
\]
The third task ends \(50\) minutes after \(2{:}40\) PM, which is \(\boxed{3{:}30\text{ PM}}\), choice B.
methods.levelReason: The solution requires only elapsed time, the hour-to-minute conversion, and division into equal shares.

candidate.annotationRationale: Elapsed time is the task-level target. The method converts the known interval into minutes, divides it into two equal task durations, and advances the finishing time by one more duration.
